strengths: No stock openers (‘Japan is a country where…’, ‘Many visitors notice one unusual thing’)
Short paragraphs, concrete verbs (toes near marks, tap a shoulder, hover at the counter)
Closing instruction (‘Use the marks. Let people off.’) is native and useful

issues.problem: ‘They do not form a polite salon in the middle of the car’ is a strained metaphor.
issues.suggestion: ‘They are not holding a polite little reception in the aisle’ or simply ‘they do not make a second polite queue in the aisle.’

issues.location: Where the Myth Gets Too Clean — rain
issues.problem: ‘The drawing just gets wet’ is clever but momentarily unclear (drawing = painted marks? geometry?).
issues.suggestion: ‘The painted shape smears; the front of the line is still there.’
Drop the label; keep the sentence.

issues.problem: Slightly pedantic; nobody asked about biology.
issues.suggestion: ‘Not by nature. Many are impatient and still stay in line…’
